_comment: Copy to security-audit.config.json (gitignored) and fill in. Read by scripts under security/scripts and tests under security/api-authz-tests. NEVER paste real tokens here; reference env vars by name (env:VAR_NAME) and the runner resolves them at run time.

testAccounts._comment: Two pre-provisioned test users in TWO different orgs. The seed script that creates them lives at apps/api/scripts/seed-security-test-accounts.ts (manual). Tokens are obtained at the start of the test run by logging in via the API; never paste raw JWTs in the config. user_a_email + password + user_b_email + password are the inputs; tokens are fetched at runtime.
testAccounts._note: Both accounts MUST exist before tests run. Their orgs MUST be disjoint (no shared membership).

endpoints._comment: Endpoints categorised so the harness knows what to attack and what to leave alone. Paths are relative to apiBaseUrl. Use {placeholder} for path params; tests substitute concrete values per scenario.
endpoints._note: Update these arrays as the API surface grows. Tests iterate over them so adding a new endpoint here automatically extends test coverage.

transport._comment: On localhost, set all three to false in your local override config.

thresholds._comment: Number of findings tolerated before the run fails. 0 = strict gate. Increase only with a documented rationale in SECURITY_REVIEW_*.md.

zap._comment: baseline = passive scan only, safe for staging. full = active scan, NEVER for production. The script refuses full mode against the production hostname.
zap._excludeNote: Exclude admin paths from active scans to avoid accidental state changes during a full scan. Baseline (passive) doesn't need exclusions.

secrets._comment: Depth 0 = full history. Increase locally if scans become slow.
